meta.title: 一人公司，高效流水线产出SOP
meta.title_en: One-Person Company: A High-Efficiency Assembly-Line SOP

scenes.title_cn: 开场：你觉得上班和一人公司最大的区别…
scenes.title_en: Opening: what's the biggest difference bet…
scenes.context: 一人公司要把重复劳动甩给工具。
sentences: 你觉得上班和一人公司最大的区别是什么？
What's the biggest difference between a job and a one-person company?
one-person company（一人公司）
这些琐事它只会消耗我们的时间，不会给我们创造价值。
These chores only consume time; they create no value.
consume time（消耗时间）
把重复性的劳动甩给别人、甩给工具，把有限的精力放在重要的决策上面。
Offload repetitive work to tools and keep your energy for key decisions.
offload repetitive work（甩掉重复劳动）
scenes.speak: What's the biggest difference between a job and a one-person company? These chores only consume time; they create no value. Offload repetitive work to tools and keep your energy for key decisions.

scenes.title_cn: 发现Work Bot：今天还是不准去…
scenes.title_en: Discovering Work Bot: today I'll break dow…
scenes.context: Work Bot的一键模板吸引了他。
sentences: 我这个一人公司是怎么流水化运作的。
This is how my one-person company runs as an assembly line.
assembly line（流水化运作）
它上面有一个叫一键做爆款，我扫了一下就出来了一个办公模板。
It has a 'one-click viral creator'; scanning it gave me an office template.
one-click viral（一键做爆款）
scenes.speak: This is how my one-person company runs as an assembly line. It has a 'one-click viral creator'; scanning it gave me an office template.

scenes.title_cn: 第一条流水线：盯行业信息：我的第一条…
scenes.title_en: Pipeline one: tracking industry info: my f…
scenes.context: AI定时扫描行业信息，模板生成选题库。
sentences: 一人公司是没有人帮你搜集信息的，所有的决策都要依靠你自己的判断力。
Nobody gathers info for you—decisions rest on your own judgment.
rely on judgment（依靠判断力）
每天早上它会自动地扫描行业的动态、竞品的动向、热门的话题。
Every morning it scans industry dynamics, competitor moves, and hot topics.
scan the dynamics（扫描动态）
把它赛道的关键词填进去，它自动就能帮我生成一版选题库。
Fill in niche keywords and it generates a topic bank.
topic bank（选题库）
scenes.speak: Nobody gathers info for you—decisions rest on your own judgment. Every morning it scans industry dynamics, competitor moves, and hot topics. Fill in niche keywords and it generates a topic bank.

scenes.title_cn: 第二条流水线：方案PPT变流水线：这…
scenes.title_en: Pipeline two: turning proposals and outlin…
scenes.context: 工作框架库把方案生成流水线化。
sentences: 一人公司每一件事你都得自己做，而且你还得从零开始做。
In a one-person company you do everything yourself, from zero.
do it all（事事亲为）
我建立了一个自己的工作框架库，把我常用的一些结构、方案模板给它录进去。
I built a personal framework library of structures and templates.
framework library（框架库）
原本可能花几天时间才能够打磨出来的，现在就一天结束了。
What took days of polishing now finishes in a day.
days to a day（几天变一天）
scenes.speak: In a one-person company you do everything yourself, from zero. I built a personal framework library of structures and templates. What took days of polishing now finishes in a day.

scenes.title_cn: 第三条流水线：数据复盘：第三个场景就…
scenes.title_en: Pipeline three: data review: my third pipe…
scenes.context: AI自动生成复盘报告指导方向。
sentences: 做一人公司有一个动作非常重要，但大家经常会忽略，就是复盘。
A crucial, often-ignored habit in a one-person company is review.
review（复盘）
它会自动帮我生成一个复盘的报告。
It auto-generates a review report.
auto report（自动报告）
下个月我该往哪个方向使劲。
Where to push next month.
where to push（往哪使劲）
scenes.speak: A crucial, often-ignored habit in a one-person company is review. It auto-generates a review report. Where to push next month.

scenes.title_cn: 结语：所以腾讯的Work Bot对我…
scenes.title_en: Conclusion: Work Bot's greatest value for …
scenes.context: 工具的价值是解放精力到高价值决策。
sentences: 它最大的价值并不是它帮我写了多少字，而是它把我从重复性的劳动中给解放出来了。
Its value isn't the words it wrote—it's freeing me from repetitive labor.
freed from labor（解放劳动）
把有限的精力放在我最感兴趣的最需要动脑子的事情上。
Put limited energy into what I love and what needs thinking.
energy on thinking（精力放思考）
scenes.speak: Its value isn't the words it wrote—it's freeing me from repetitive labor. Put limited energy into what I love and what needs thinking.

practice: All trivial tasks land on you and create no value.
Offload repetitive work to tools and people.
A scheduled AI scans trends and pushes relevant news.
Record structures so drafts generate from key points.
Feed platform data to auto-generate a review report.
pitfalls: 判断力建立在信息质量上。
Build a framework library for instant drafts.
Review what worked and where to push.
Value them by freeing you for high-level decisions.
工具的价值是解放精力。
shifts: 用 repetitive labor（重复劳动）、assembly line（流水化）、offload（甩掉）
用 industry dynamics（行业动态）、topic bank（选题库）、judgment（判断力）
用 data source（数据源）、retention（留存）、auto report（自动报告）
